latestVersion.changelog:
OpenArt AI — Initial Release

- Generate AI art and 1080p MP4 videos from text prompts or image uploads (PNG, JPG, WebP, MP4 up to 200MB).
- Automatic setup with anonymous token and session creation for quick, frictionless starts.
- Supports editing, credits check, exporting, and viewing session state via simple user commands.
- Cloud GPU processing delivers AI art and video within ~20-40 seconds; all major media formats supported.
- Built-in error handling, timeline summaries, and guidance for digital artists and content creators.
